description: Inspect a managed .NET assembly (.dll/.exe) from its ECMA-335 metadata (ADR-0004): runtime version, assembly identity, assembly references, type names, method count, P/Invoke native imports (module + function), user-string literals, and entry-point token. Reads metadata only under hard caps; the assembly is never loaded or run, and every name and string is AIDefence-screened before return. Use when you need the dependency and native-call surface of a .NET binary before deciding where to dig deeper — not for IL disassembly or decompilation, which this does not do. A native (non-managed) PE returns isManaged:false.

path.description: Absolute path to a .NET assembly (.dll or .exe)

name: rure_analyze_dotnet
